subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Is the July 8 proof enough to waive the remaining legacy no-code SQLite upgrade proof ask for this PR?
rationale: The patch changes persisted registry upgrade behavior, and the new author comment describes CI/tests rather than showing a latest-head real run for the legacy row rederive/startup path.

options.title: Require Latest-Head Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the source proof and regression tests as enough, but that waives the external real-behavior proof gate for upgraded persisted state.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and require the legacy no-code cleanup to move into doctor or migration-owned code instead of steady-state registry invalidation.

recommendation.title: Require Latest-Head Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.
